timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I'll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you'll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let's begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Work is feeling like a lot right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I'm carrying more pressure than I'd like.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: It's okay that this feels like a lot.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don't have to solve everything in this moment.
I can handle one task at a time.
I don't have to prove everything today.
I can let my shoulders drop a little.
I'm doing more than I'm giving myself credit for.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I'm ready to keep going, one step at a time.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. That's yours now — take it with you.
